result.summary: The home screen is mostly polished, but several cards and chips are clipped by the viewport edges, which is the main visual break. Promo banner contrast and a few overlapping labels are smaller issues.

issues.description: The last category chip (Healthy) and the last Fastest-near-you card (Trattoria Piccol…) are cut off at the right edge, so names and controls look truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding or fade/peek so the last item is fully visible, or make the carousels clearly swipeable with more of the next card shown.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with −20%) is cropped by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so cards sit fully above the tab bar, or allow the list to scroll so the last card is not covered.

issues.description: Promo banner body text (“Use code TALLINN3…”) is very light on the mint background and is hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text or increase contrast against the green banner.

issues.description: Time badges sit on top of the food photos and slightly cover the dishes, especially on the burger and pasta cards.
issues.suggestion: Give badges more padding/offset or a stronger scrim so they don’t collide with the artwork.

issues.description: Notification bell badge sits tight against the icon circle and looks slightly cramped.
issues.suggestion: Nudge the red dot inward or enlarge the hit area so it doesn’t clip the icon ring.
